entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3143264535611892096: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 36188: distance 49.579 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.01), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 49.579 +/- 0.496 pc; Gaia DR3 gives this source no parallax (a two-parameter solution). Proper motion: Gaia DR3 source 3143264535611892096 is a two-parameter solution with no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 50 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 0 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3143264535611892096 (quality C), from 1993BICDS..43....5T; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 5.671 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 36188: radius 5.671 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 130.459 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.863) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 8197 +/- 3804 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 36188: effective temperature 8197 +/- 3804 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.319).

entries.subject: Color

Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 58715 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 2845 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 2845 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 2845 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; kharitonov: used.
